title: Betty Jane Releases Debut Single, "You Been Warned" - A Groovy and Energetic Soul Dance Party
htmlContent:
Betty Jane, a rising star in the soul and R&B music scene, has released her debut single, "You Been Warned." The song is a lively and energetic throwback to the classic sounds of The Capitols, The Temptations, and early Stevie Wonder, and features the Heavy Duty Horns, NYC's illustrious horn section.

With vibrant background vocals showcasing Betty Jane's harmonic prowess, "You Been Warned" is a sparkling and sassy soul dance party. The song's infectious beat and catchy lyrics are sure to get listeners grooving and singing along.

Betty Jane's debut single is a fun and upbeat addition to any modern or classic soul dance party playlist, and is equally at home among retro pop artists like Meghan Trainor or authentic soul artists like Martha & the Vandellas.

"You Been Warned" is just the beginning for Betty Jane, who is poised to make a big splash in the soul and R&B music world. With her soulful voice, dynamic stage presence, and infectious energy, Betty Jane is an artist to watch.

Listeners can stream "You Been Warned" on all major music platforms now.
